items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, they used to work together. They worked with Claude.

ctx.x: nice. I think I'd like that". And I did, and the place would be packed with musicians because I'd cook the things they'd like. They liked the red beans, and rice, and spareribs. We used to have those real happy parties. I'd just cook the hot rolls and things. I used to get off work and they used to come. I would be upstairs sleeping and Charlie would call and he's say, 'here's all the musicians'. I said, 'okay, I'll be right down'. And I'd come on down. You know, I enjoyed doing some things. Like when I got with…
Now listen, while you were there in Albany, you visited Virginia Scott and Joy, didn't you?
Yeah, they used to work together. They worked with Claude.
